about: Sources of the 3D keyboard's and mouse's click sounds, made into clips by tools/make_clicks.mjs (build.sh). The recordings live in vendor/sounds/ (not in git). Interim: CC0 recordings from Freesound until Devon records his own Mac Plus keyboard and mouse; then point these entries at his files.
